cases.name: answer-lone
cases.about: A lone open question, answered at once.

cases.name: answer-unproven
cases.about: Setup: the server timed out the probe. That proves nothing: the sender goes.

cases.name: answer-submit
cases.about: The Submit tab on a core row: two of three questions, the group stays.

cases.name: answer-held-core-before-b3
cases.about: History: a core row before B3, which production no longer reaches (CORE_DELIVERY is on). Recorded, no worker, no sender. check_answers has it.

cases.name: answer-held-core-down
cases.about: Setup: hc proves herdr-core is not running. The core worker is ensured, no sender.

cases.name: answer-skips-no-draft
cases.about: A named question with no draft is skipped, as Submit does.

cases.name: answer-nothing-to-send
cases.about: Only a question with no draft: nothing changes, nothing starts.

cases.name: answer-first-question-closed
cases.about: A group whose first question closed earlier keeps its id.

cases.name: answer-held-no-server
cases.about: Setup: herdr says NotRunning on the stored socket. Recorded, the worker ensured, no sender.

cases.name: answer-held-no-pane
cases.about: A row with neither a pane nor a terminal: only check_answers can return it.

cases.name: draft
cases.about: A draft changes the token: the result has the new one.

cases.name: draft-clear
cases.about: Clearing a draft changes the token too.

cases.name: draft-normalises-to-nothing
cases.about: A detail that normalises to nothing clears the draft.

cases.name: dismiss-question
cases.about: One question of a group.

cases.name: dismiss-group
cases.about: The whole group: the row is gone.

cases.name: retry-tui
cases.about: A TUI row is forced. The row stays, with a new token.

cases.name: retry-core
cases.about: A core row is never forced.

cases.name: retry-held-core-before-b3
cases.about: History: a core row before B3, which production no longer reaches (CORE_DELIVERY is on). The counter moves, nothing starts.

cases.name: retry-other-server
cases.about: The stored server goes to both the worker and the sender, not the default socket.

cases.name: retry-no-stored-server
cases.about: No stored server but a session: the verb's own default, under the conversation guard.

cases.name: retry-held-no-session
cases.about: No stored server and no session: the recipient rule beats retry.

cases.name: retry-held
cases.about: Setup: herdr says NotRunning on the stored socket. The counter moves, the worker is ensured, no sender.

cases.name: retry-replay
cases.about: Setup: retry-tui ran and its result was lost. The same command again is refused.

cases.name: retry-already-sending
cases.about: Setup: another process took a live claim on Q8 after this feed was read.

cases.name: stop-showing
cases.about: The ⚠ row goes; check_answers still has the answer.

cases.name: stop-showing-during-claim
cases.about: Setup: a process holds a live claim on Q30. The row is hidden, the send goes on.

cases.name: ack
cases.about: An alert acknowledged.

cases.name: stale-token
cases.about: The feed was read before the agent withdrew Q16: the database is stale-token.json.

cases.name: stale-alert-token
cases.about: A token that does not match, on an open alert.

cases.name: stale-answered
cases.about: Setup: the TUI popup answered Q12 after this feed was read.

cases.name: stale-dismissed
cases.about: Setup: the TUI popup dismissed Q12 after this feed was read.

cases.name: stale-withdrawn
cases.about: Setup: the agent withdrew Q12 after this feed was read.

cases.name: stale-removed
cases.about: Setup: Q12 is no longer in the database after this feed was read.

cases.name: stale-delivered
cases.about: Setup: Q8 was delivered after this feed was read.

cases.name: stale-fetched
cases.about: Setup: the agent fetched Q8 with check_answers after this feed was read.

cases.name: stale-hidden
cases.about: Setup: the popup stopped showing Q8 after this feed was read.

cases.name: stale-acked
cases.about: Setup: the popup acknowledged A6 after this feed was read.

cases.name: stale-cleared
cases.about: Setup: the agent is no longer waiting after this feed was read.

cases.name: invalid-choice
cases.about: A label the question does not have.

cases.name: invalid-two-choices
cases.about: Two choices on a question without multi_select.

cases.name: invalid-repeated-choice
cases.about: One label twice.

cases.name: invalid-empty-answer
cases.about: A detail that normalises to nothing is no answer.

cases.name: invalid-other-group
cases.about: A --question of another group.

stdout.message: Q12 is not an open question of this group

cases.name: invalid-detail-on-several-open
cases.about: --detail with answer needs a lone open question.

stdout.message: This group has several open questions: use draft, then answer

cases.name: read-only-remote
cases.about: Remote rows take no verbs in v1; they have no token.

stdout.message: Answer this in the herdr popup

cases.name: read-only-wrong-verb
cases.about: A verb the row's actions do not list.

stdout.message: This row does not take that action

cases.name: busy
cases.about: Setup: another process holds the write lock for the whole budget.

stdout.message: The inbox database is busy; try again in a moment

cases.name: not-migrated
cases.about: Setup: the database is not at this code's revision.

stdout.message: The inbox is being upgraded; try again in a few seconds

cases.name: error
cases.about: Setup: the database file cannot be read.

stdout.message: The inbox database failed: unable to open database file

cases.name: show
cases.about: A cut question in full: the published token, no text cut.
